title: Xanthe and the Kitchen
author: Ansel Nystrom
blurb: Rafael Amberdale, a wedding planner who doesn't believe in weddings anymore, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces before the festival ends.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
